rest: Rest for some hours (the inn's room)
trade_chest: Take from or put into a chest, a barrel or a body (the items box)
trade_storage: Move goods between the hold and a rented storage
trade_store: Buy and sell goods in a store or with a ship met at sea
nations: The nations' relations, the hero's standing with each and the flag the ship flies
trade_contraband: Buy and sell goods with smugglers
trade_cannons: Buy and sell a ship's guns
trade_items: Buy and sell items with a merchant
crew_hire: Hire sailors in a tavern, or dismiss them
sail_emblem: Paint an emblem on the ship's sails at the shipyard, or take it off
self_repair: Repair the squadron's ships with the planks and sailcloth in their holds
card_encounter: A ship sighted on the world map: engage or sail on
card_course: A ship sighted while sailing straight to an island
card_leave_battle: Leave a battle with companions still in it
card_wages: Pay the crew's wages or refuse
news_colony: News of a colony (a siege, a capture)
news_nations: News between two nations (war, peace, alliance)
interlude: A moment passing: a line over a dark scene or a picture
fort_capture: A captured fort: the game closes it at once, nothing is drawn
map_atlas: The hero's atlas: the maps he carries, one shown
map_best: The excellent map: every colony, its trade and the trade assistant
map_paper: The paper map of the islands and their colonies
tradebook: The prices the hero has seen in each colony, colony by colony
journal: The hero's journal: quests, documents, assets and statistics as the game records them
trade_loot: Take the goods of a captured town's stores into the hold
items: What a person of the company carries and wears, and the game's action on one of their things
shipyard: Buy, sell and trade in ships at a shipyard, repair them and give a bought one a captain
table_dice: Dice against a tavern's patron, as the game deals and decides them
table_cards: Cards (twenty-one) against a tavern's patron, as the game deals and decides them
transfer: Exchange cargo and crew with another ship: a boarded prize, a companion, a ship met at sea
ship: A ship of the hero's squadron: its figures, crew and hold, its guns set, goods thrown overboard
